name: Waste Connections, Inc.
base_source: TTM through Q2 2026 from 10-Q YTD figures in Q2 2026 release: OCF $2,513.214M (FY25 $2,414.069M - H1'25 $1,179.741M + H1'26 $1,278.886M) - capex $1,280.412M - SBC $79.031M = $1,153.771M / 254.861M diluted shares = $4.53/share
moat_justification: Permitted landfill airspace is scarce/irreplaceable, route density in exclusive/secondary markets, internalization 59% and rising, proven pricing power (core price +6.5% FY25, +5.8% H1'26) and industry-leading ~33% adj. EBITDA margin, long municipal/franchise contracts — against larger WM/Republic bidders, rebid risk, no network effects, negative unit volumes, commodity/E&P cyclicality, and landfill closure/environmental liabilities (Chiquita Canyon).
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 5.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
one_liner: Strong-moat (7/10) waste compounder with real pricing power, but at $153.71 (34x TTM owner's earnings of $4.53/share, 2.9% yield) it yields a 7.1% weighted IRR — clears the 15% hurdle only at ~$52 (~$42 with a margin of safety); even the super-bull case ($105.57) is below today's price.
